notes_for_editor: Story is about 70 words, below the 120-word floor. The only tower-specific source is the list row, whose sole note 'topo' most likely means the point was taken from a topographic map (the list uses 'topo 1950' elsewhere), so it may not be a documented built lookout. Two searches and cache checks found no history, staffing or fate. Recommend the editor decide whether to publish a location-only entry or hold it until a Georgia Forestry Commission or Emanuel County historical source is found. Elevation 260 is in the list with no unit, so it is omitted from the story.
